messages:
Alex: Saturday question  crepe festival at 11am or beginner surf lesson at 7:30am? tiny favor: vote and say if you need gear. :pancakes::surfing_man:
Rina: crepes for me. will eat my weight in Nutella. also can bring a picnic blanket.
Diego: surf lesson — been meaning to get off the shorebreak fear. i need a board rental.
Alex: surf group meets at Ocean St boat ramp 7:15 if you want to carpool. crepe crew meets by the big striped tent at 10:45.
Rina: is the crepe fest cash-only? someone check vendor page?
ops-bot: Heads up: Crepe Fest vendors accept cards but some stalls are cash-only. Street parking near the park closes at 10:30 for a farmers market.
Diego: thanks @ops-bot. @Alex do you know about renting boards?
Alex: Surf school has rentals included if you book the 7:30 slot. Link: https://example.com/surf-beginners (use code REDWOOD10 for 10% off)
Rina: voting: "crepe" or "surf"
Alex: surf
Diego: surf
Rina: crepe
Alex: looks like 2 surf, 1 crepe. but crepe people still welcome to join post-surf.
Diego: also quick note: wetsuits run small. if you're between sizes, size up.
Rina: ok i'll swing by after and grab a crepe for the post-surf celebration. save me something sweet!
Alex: plan: surf takes majority. meet Ocean St boat ramp 7:15, wetsuit on, bring a towel and a change of clothes. post-surf crepe meetup ~11:30 under the big tent. i'll post exact crepe location after lesson.
Diego: hyped. shoutout to @Alex for promo code. see you early :coffee:
Rina: see you later! i'll bring napkins. :blush:
